HOW LONG DOES IT NORMALLY TAKE TO SHIP AND SEND A TRACKING NUMBER?
Orders are processed in 2–3 BUSINESS DAYS before shipment. After the order ships, you should receive a SHIPPING CONFIRMATION EMAIL with your tracking number. Once that email is sent, tracking can take 24–48 HOURS to start updating on the carrier’s website.
It’s also recommended to check your SPAM/JUNK FOLDER for the shipping confirmation email.
If you want help with your specific order, please log in to your account and I can help with order details.
